answer: Require each new agent to post a bond, locked until its actions pass a challenge window. If a verified fraud report succeeds, the bond is burned and the reporter is rewarded. Honest agents reclaim theirs, but an attacker creating many identities must tie up capital in each and risk losing it. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes Sybil influence costly. A delta in bond size raises the price of attack, draining the lagoon of cheap accounts and puncturing the fable that identities are free.
